messages:
Rajesh Bhaskar: Hey everyone! 👋 First day at Redwood — super excited to be here. I used to run a tiny weekly podcast about espresso machines + sci-fi books (2-3 min episodes) and might try to sneak a few desktop recordings between onboarding sessions. Quick Q: is there a good spot near the office for a fast leakproof travel mug refill? Also I can't figure out where the slack channel for 'boardgame night' is.
Lila Ortiz: Welcome Rajesh!! :tada: There's a water station by the 3rd-floor kitchenette that has filtered hot water — perfect for travel mugs. For board games, check #random or ping @games — folks usually organize there. What kind of espresso machine do you use? ☕
Rajesh Bhaskar: Thanks Lila — I'll check those. I have a little lever machine (La Pavoni) so I usually do short pulls. If anyone wants an evidence-backed opinion on tamping angles, I will happily overshare. 😅
Mira Patel: Welcome! If you're into short recordings, we have a quiet nook near the south wing (near the green couch) that no one books — good for a 10-15 min take. Also FYI, new-hire lunch is Friday at 12:30 if you wanna join.
Rajesh Bhaskar: Ooh perfect, I'll bring a couple of biscotti and maybe record a 2-min intro episode — "New at Redwood: espresso, infra, and why I love token economies" (joke title). When's the lunch RSVP deadline?
Sam (People Ops): Hey Rajesh — welcome again! Lunch RSVP is open until Thursday 5pm, here's the form: https://intranet/redwood/lunch-rsvp. We'll also add you to the #new-hires Slack huddle later this week. If you need a keyboard or monitor request, file a ticket in #devex-help and tag me.
DevEx Bot: Automated note: New hire checklist for Rajesh created. Onboarding docs: https://docs.redwood/integrations/onboarding · New-hire swag: fill this form: https://forms.redwood/swag
Lila Ortiz: Also — tiny poll: who prefers tea over coffee? :tea: or :coffee: (Rajesh you can post your podcast link here later!).
Rajesh Bhaskar: Coffee all the way, but I respect ceremonial tea. Thanks for the warm welcome everyone — see you at lunch and in #random for boardgame talks! :wave:
